decisionRule: CONSENT only if no MUST-FIX and no SHOULD-FIX. Every attack run was refuted, so the verdict is CONSENT.
decision: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. CLAUDE-D303-T2-SF1 is landed exactly as its repair specified: the Protocol line carries the bare house form 'Lands CLAUDE-D303-MF1.' with no parenthetical, and the repair's optional branch - citing the frozen turn-1 subject digest instead of quoting the deleted sentence - is executed verbatim. CLAUDE-D303-MF1 remains landed in the Decision limb and its own measurement re-runs to 0 on the turn-3 bytes. The turn-2 to turn-3 delta is confined to the Protocol line and the tail of the Decision limb; nothing else moved. Every load-bearing claim was re-derived from primary sources: seven digests recomputed, two commit ids resolved at full length, the sole intervening file-08 commit re-derived from git log, the DR-111 status token and all readiness numbers read from live file 08, and every named identifier resolved to a pinned review. The one serious attack - that turn 3 dropped the turn-1 review pins - was pursued hard and defeated by the turn-3 draft corpus, where the prior-turn digest block belongs to the adoption-time Status limb rather than the draft's Protocol line.

observations.title: The strongest available attack - that turn 3 dropped the turn-1 review citations the turn-2 draft carried - was pursued at length and defeated by the turn-3 draft corpus.
observations.measurement: The turn-2 to turn-3 diff removes the turn-1 Claude review pin (7b8bf0dd...) and the turn-1 Codex review pin (339bdf78...), while the entry still names five turn-1 identifiers and asserts three facts about turn-1 review contents. Every adopted multi-turn entry checked (D-240, D-260, D-283, D-284, D-294 at turn 3; D-302 at turn 2) pins every prior turn's reviews, so the attack looked strong. It fails on the layer distinction: those digest blocks live in the adoption-time Status limb, and the frozen turn-3 DRAFTS that produced them cite no review digests at all (D-294 turn-3 draft: grep -c 'review-adversarial' returns 0; D-283 turn-3 draft names bare identifiers only). The D-303 turn-3 draft cites strictly more than both. Independently, the turn-2 Claude review's priorTurn object pins both turn-1 digests, so the chain is retrievable in one hop from a digest the draft does cite.

observations.title: The parenthetical form rejected at CLAUDE-D303-T2-SF1 did have a same-day draft-layer precedent, which the finding's COORD-scoped measurement did not reach.
observations.measurement: The frozen D-302 turn-2 draft's Protocol line reads 'Lands CLAUDE-D302-S-1 (Subject paragraph: leftover-design per-D-002-platform copies ...)' - the same 'Lands X (...)' construction. CLAUDE-D303-T2-SF1's measurement was scoped to the adopted register ('the Lands X construction appears 21 times in COORD and is bare in every one of them'), and that remains true: D-302's adopted Decision limb reads 'Claude Stage B turn-1 SHOULD-FIX CLAUDE-D302-S-1 is landed', with no parenthetical. The finding stands as measured; recorded here because the draft layer, which the finding did not measure, is one instance less unanimous than the register.

observations.title: COORD is hard-wrapped, so naive multi-word greps return false zeros; two attacks in this review had to be re-run on a normalised copy.
observations.measurement: grep -c 'Not a D-000 amendment' on COORD returns 0 even though D-294's Decision-type limb contains the phrase, because it wraps as 'Not a\n  D-000 amendment'. The same artifact produced a false 0 for 'Not a required-now successor'. Both cleared once measured against tr '\n' ' ' | tr -s ' '. Any future precedent count over COORD phrases longer than about four words should be taken on the normalised text; single-line artifacts such as the frozen drafts and the review JSONs are unaffected.

observations.title: 'The four reserved surfaces' was pursued as an invented count against the live DR-111 row and defeated by the frozen subject's own bytes.
observations.measurement: The live DR-111 row enumerates core/index/control, each provider major, component API, state schema and evidence formats, which does not read as four. But the count is the frozen artifact's, at five sites, and compatibility-leftover-join.v3 carries dual independent ACCEPT 0/0; the artifact also holds numericWindowsVerbatim RESERVED, so the number of reserved surfaces is its own reserved vocabulary, not a register arithmetic claim. The draft transcribes rather than mints. Any redefinition belongs to limb (ii), which this entry expressly does not perform.
